data.one_liner: Desktop WebView powered by Chromium Embedded Framework (CEF).
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter widget that renders web content using a full Chromium engine on Windows, macOS, and Linux. It offers GPU zero‑copy rendering, JavaScript bridge, cookie management, and multi‑instance support.
use_when: You need full desktop‑class web standards (WebGL, HTML5 video, etc.)
You want high‑performance rendering with zero‑copy GPU paths
You require a JavaScript‑to‑Dart bridge or custom user‑script injection
avoid_when: You need a minimal binary size or want to avoid native C++ toolchains
You prefer a plug‑and‑play webview without extra build steps
strengths: Full Chromium engine with modern web standards
Adaptive frame‑rate and real‑time IME support
weaknesses: Requires C++20 toolchain and large CEF download (~330 MB)
Complex native setup (modify runner code, podfile hooks)
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, edit windows/runner/main.cpp to init CEF and forward messages, add macOS podfile post_install hook to embed CEF helpers, set WEBVIEW_CEF_MACOS_ARCH if needed, ensure C++20 compiler, download CEF binaries on first build.

alternatives.name: webview_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Simpler setup, works on mobile and desktop with no native C++ requirements, but lacks full Chromium features and zero‑copy rendering.
